listing.name: PowerSlave / Exhumed (DOS) (PCExhumed)
listing.summary: Play PowerSlave / Exhumed (DOS) through PCExhumed using your own matching game files.

steps.title: Extract the matching Windows player
steps.instruction: Choose the pcexhumed_win64 archive. Extract the complete archive to a folder for this game and keep pcexhumed.exe with its packaged files.

steps.title: Add your game files to this copy
steps.instruction: Use STUFF.DAT, DEMO.VCR and BOOK.MOV from a supported DOS PowerSlave or Exhumed retail copy or the PowerSlave demo linked by upstream. Other demo versions may differ. Keep the original copy separately.

steps.title: Run setup and play again
steps.instruction: Use the extracted folder as the working directory and start pcexhumed.exe with -usecwd. Complete the startup window if it opens. After saving a working configuration, try -nosetup for direct Play. Use -setup to reopen the startup settings.

warnings: The upstream guide reports that demo playback is unfinished. That refers to recorded gameplay, separate from using files from the supported demo edition.

references.title: Keep the game folder and its saves
references.instruction: With -usecwd, keep the game folder, settings and saved data together. Back up this folder before replacing a working copy with a newer upstream release. You manage replacement and backups for this upstream copy.

references.title: Adjust PCExhumed settings
references.instruction: After the first run, the upstream guide describes editing settings.cfg for mouse inversion and field of view.

references.title: Reuse an existing Steam or GOG copy
references.instruction: The upstream player can find a supported Steam or GOG installation. To try this, start the player without -usecwd before copying originals. Keep the existing installation, and check where the player writes settings and saves on that route.
